title: Decimal Exact-Fill Minimum Items
prompt:
You have a layover in Paris with `target` hours remaining and a list of Airbnb experiences, represented by their durations in hours. Each duration and `target` has at most one decimal place.

You want to minimize context switching, so book as few experiences as possible while using exactly all `target` hours. You may book the same experience more than once. If no combination fills the time exactly, book nothing and stay at the airport.

Implement `min_exact_items(durations, target) -> int`. Return the minimum number of bookings, or `0` when no exact booking is possible. A zero-hour target also returns `0`. Treat the stated one-decimal values exactly. Assume every duration is positive and `target` is nonnegative.

example.reasoning: Book the 2-hour experience twice and the 3-hour experience once: 2 + 2 + 3 = 7 hours.

references.label: 1Point3Acres: Airbnb MLE onsite exact-fill report (decimal durations, repeat allowed)
